articles.title: Quote of the day by Michel Foucault: 'Maybe the target nowadays is not to discover what we are but to refuse what we are' and how every self-help guru got it wrong

He asserted that true freedom lies in critically examining and discarding these imposed identities. Today, power operates subtly through institutions dictating people's identities. Furthermore, technology and algorithms play a role in shaping digital personas, echoing Foucault's warnings. Choosing to resist these labels empowers individuals to transcend predefined identities.
